title: Container Bookings: carrier rolls still owing roll compensation
content:
## Rule
Under the Container Bookings product line, only rolls recorded with the carrier as initiator earn compensation; customer rolls never do. The carrier rolls still owing compensation are the booking's roll entries recorded with the carrier as initiator, less its roll compensation entries. They are credited in the order they were recorded, one credit entry per roll, each referencing the roll entry it compensates. When no carrier roll is still owing compensation, nothing is credited.

## Input, judgement, output (hypothetical ledgers)
| Carrier roll entries | Roll compensation entries | Carrier rolls still owing | Next credit references |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1, recorded 4 March | 0 | 1 | the 4 March roll |
| 2, recorded 4 and 18 March | 1, referencing the 4 March roll | 1 | the 18 March roll |
| 2, recorded 4 and 18 March | 2 | 0 | nothing is credited |
| 0 (only customer rolls) | 0 | 0 | nothing is credited |

*Dates and counts are hypothetical inputs, for illustration only.*

## Points of judgement
**Two carrier rolls are owing. Can one entry cover both?** No. One credit entry is written per roll, each referencing its own roll entry, in the order the rolls were recorded.
